I’ve seen countless names shilled on the timeline / fomo over the last month.

Majority of them die out, and as they do so do the voices who posted about them.

I’ve been bullish on Robinhood Chain since early July.

I haven’t talked about many coins, but I’ve been incredibly consistent about what I have regardless of where the price is, because I like to stack narratives I believe in.

Some people don’t like that, which is understandable.

But I believe we’re so early in this new bull market now is the time to be extremely vocal about opportunities you believe have outsized potential.

And usually, a good trade is controversial early on.

By the time it’s not, you’ve missed a lot of the upside.

Imagine knowing you were vocal about a PEPE, SHIB, POPCAT, WIF, etc. from the early days as they define narratives for the next bull market.

So my fomo account hasn’t about nailing a million small 2x’s or even 10x’s. It’s mostly been about finding plays I can be patient in for a 100x or a 1000x.

Hmm… Learn to bullieve in something again 🤔🐈
